newsitem.title: USA: Pittston Brink's says hurt by competition.
newsitem.headline: Pittston Brink's says hurt by competition.

text.p: Pittston Brink, the home and industrial security division of the Pittston Co, said competition has cut into installation fees and caused it to raise marketing and sales costs.

The company said in a statement, that as a result of aggressive pricing and marketing by competitors, Brinks Home Security (BHS) experiencing lower installation fees and higher marketing and sales costs.

The company went on to say in a statement that as the second quarter progressed, industry pricing appeared to be stabilizing. As a result, Pittston Brink said operating profit was negatively impacted approximately $1.9 million from 1996's second quarter. However, revenues from its security monitoring business increased as a result of a greater number of subscribers and higher monitoring fees per subscriber.
